purpose: Bind the same-path publication callee and make the rename/context resource boundary explicit after the full write_snapshot_with_memory_publication body hit a Verus frontend limitation on the source and_then closure capturing mutable staging state
observation: StagingDirectory::publish retires the staging owner exactly on rename/context success; on rename/context error it returns before retirement and leaves the staging owner path unchanged, while the external filesystem success choice remains outside the method parameters
guarantees_added: Adds exact-fragment source binding for StagingDirectory::publish, a proof-side postcondition that a successful publish retires the staging path after the no-replace rename returns success, an error postcondition that the staging owner path is unchanged, and a concrete Context::with_context result-shape contract.
guarantees_removed: Does not claim the full write_snapshot_with_memory_publication orchestrator is proved; staging failure, rollback classification, committed parent-sync failure, and final success remain open at that caller.
domain_change: Narrows this registered non-model candidate from the full publication orchestrator to the same-path staging publish callee because the full source body currently uses a mutable-capturing closure unsupported by Verus.
trust_change: rename_no_replace remains an explicit environment and filesystem resource interface: the Linux-GNU source path calls renameat2 with RENAME_NOREPLACE, while non-Linux-GNU fallback semantics are still open. Formatting allocation/display behavior, Path/PathBuf representation, platform no-replace semantics, races, and resource effects remain unproved dependencies. The verifier selector is `crate#StagingDirectory::publish`, which the installed adapter normalizes to the exact proof symbol in source_binding.
